name: Karametra
description: The god patron of Setessa who nominally serves as its queen and is the god of orphans.

description_citations.text: "Setessa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Years later, Raissa escapes a burning house with her six-year-old son, who set her bed alight; they have been cast out of Setessa after he pushed a council member's son to his death.
timeline.quote: He had caused them to be cast out of Setessa when he shoved the son of one of the Karametra temple's ruling council to his death from a high rope bridge among the trees.

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Erebos sends Athreos to take Daxos to the Underworld; despite Karametra's efforts Athreos seizes the boy, and Lidia offers herself in his place and is taken instead.
timeline.quote: Lidia offered herself in her son's place and was taken to the Underworld instead.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At six, Cilissa is brought to Setessa as an orphan and receives a vision of Karametra.
timeline.quote: A vision of Karametra hovered in the starfield of Nyx above Cilissa

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karametra's sparks create glowing pods whose warmth brings Cilissa memories of her parents' fall to Akroan attackers.
timeline.quote: Her father fell to the first wave of Akroan attackers.

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cilissa kills the gorgon with her axe and lures a minotaur into cleaving open Karametra's pod, dissolving all Nyxborn.
timeline.quote: All the Nyxborn slowly dissolved into nothingness.

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Months later, Cilissa welcomes a new group of orphaned children with Karametra's voice.
timeline.quote: She let her voice be infused by the presence of Karametra

citation.text: "Cilissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lidia trades herself for her son and Karametra's emissary takes Daxos to safety.
timeline.quote: Lidia traded herself for her son

citation.text: "Daxos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Erebos sends Athreos to fetch Daxos for his oracular gift; Lidia takes her son's place and is brought to the Underworld.
timeline.quote: thus she was brought to the Underworld while Daxos was left alone in the Mortal Realm.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In legend Karametra lays waste to her temples for a year and causes famine; humanity fasts and prays for seven days and she relents with a miraculous grape harvest.
timeline.quote: Moved by their sincerity, Karametra relented, blessing the world with a miraculous grape harvest that cured illness and ended the famine.

citation.text: "Karametra", section "The Years of Rage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karametra is affected by the Silence of the Gods, when divine intervention ceased.
timeline.quote: Karametra was affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Karametra", section "Silence of the Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karametra teaches people to live in harmony with nature, leading to the founding of Setessa.
timeline.quote: the god Karametra tried to teach people a new way of living in harmony with nature, leading to the founding of Setessa

citation.text: "Setessa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karametra's priest Thamuzus dies at the Miraculous Field, to which Karametra pays tribute.
timeline.quote: The field is said to be Karametra's tribute to her beloved human priest, Thamuzus , who died there.

citation.text: "Setessa", section "Locations within Setessa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Has a bond with the goddess.
relations.quote: who has a bond with the goddess Karametra

citation.text: "Ephara", section "Relationships". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The serene, wise god of the harvest, hearth and protection, strongly associated with Setessa, who governs the defense of home and territory.

citation.work: The Gods of Born of the Gods
citation.text: "The Gods of Born of the Gods" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2014.
